snippet.title: Rawr: A Psychological Horror Game - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A house that isn't safe. A mind that won't settle.

Rawr is a short, atmospheric game about trying to find somewhere that feels less unsafe. Thoughts instead of dialogue. Sensory overwhelm instead of combat.

Chapter 1 is complete. Chapter 2 is in development but still playable now.

Content warning: trauma, dissociation, implied emotional abuse.

Play Rawr: https://roflrawrvt.itch.io/rawr

Some feelings do not have words.#indiehorror  #psychologicalhorror  #godot  #indiegame  #horrorgaming
